rev7's source-trust criterion was defeated three consecutive times by one root-cause family, each a different SPELLING of 'the caller's path may alias the canonical file': outside alias to the real canonical committed file (found at 0e85e76, closed by e7712dd), parent-directory symlink (impl-r3 on e7712dd, closed by c5fce58), and a symlink hop cancelled by '..' (impl-r4 on c5fce58, still open). The orchestrator independently reproduced all three. The root cause is structural, not a missing case: _lexical_absolute() calls normpath() first, collapsing 'hop/..' lexically so the symlink component never appears in any inspected path, and _no_symlinked_component() walks only the canonical rel rather than the caller's spelling. agentic autonomy signal rework_twice reported SOFT_LIMIT_ENABLED, so instead of a fourth same-shape patch the orchestrator escalated the approach choice to the user, who selected direction A (canonicalize once). rev8 rewrites INV-3b rule 3 to derive the trusted path from the registered worktree root plus the canonical rel, lstat it per component, compare the caller's UNNORMALIZED spelling for byte equality, and read only the derived path; it adds the dotdot-hop E9 shape and mutations M-2h/M-2i. Nothing else changes: the four-field exemption shape, lint semantics, INV-3c/3d/4/5/6/7, scope and the forbidden-path list are untouched.

Direction A is unchanged.

Brief second signature wp03-brief-r5 returned a VALID REWORK on one defect, independently measured by the orchestrator: rev9's R3-a stage 1 specified locating the file via the EXISTING _resolve_plan_path(), which joins a relative path against main_repo(). In the real deployment the PLAN file exists ONLY in the integration worktree -- _resolve_plan_path('docs/plans/<iter>/PLAN-01.status.json') points at /Users/admin/vibe/agentic_loop/... with exists()==False -- so stage 1 would fail before iteration_id/plan_id/base_branch could be extracted. rev9's own E16(b) (the published relative spelling must still merge) was therefore unsatisfiable together with R3-a; this is the same bootstrap limitation the orchestrator already hit running `agentic plan check` with a relative path. rev10 freezes a separate rule for the relative form: stage 0 lexical classification, then deterministic candidate discovery across the registered worktrees requiring a UNIQUE existing candidate (zero or several both fail closed), then a stage-2 self-consistency recheck that the discovered worktree is the same one base_branch selects and that the file's iteration_id/plan_id match the corresponding path components byte-for-byte. Adds E18 (four branches: unique candidate merges, zero candidates fail closed, multiple candidates fail closed, forged fields fail closed) and mutations M-2l (revert relative location to _resolve_plan_path -> E18(a)/E16(b) red) and M-2m (drop candidate uniqueness -> E18(c) red). Brief second signature wp03-brief-r6 returned a VALID REWORK on one over-correction, independently measured by the orchestrator: rev10's R3-a required the EXISTING candidate files to be unique before reading. But this repository supports parallel lanes, and a lane worktree branched off the integration branch INHERITS the same relative path. F5: INV-3c first-read byte binding, INV-3d refs/mutation separation, rule 4's derived-path blob comparison and the DoD's positive/negative mutations are mutually consistent.
